name: Ivo de Taillebois

intro.text: Halt! I am Ivo de Taillebois, lord of these fens for King William. This causeway is the King's, and that rebel Hereward will not slip away again!
Draw, peasant. In the name of the Conqueror.

win: Mon Dieu. Sunk in the fen, like the King's causeway.
after: Go, then. The rebel waits in the reeds. Tell him William sends his regards, and a very large army.
